summary: A tenant disputing the first regulated rent for {apartment} needs the special guideline for a formerly controlled unit.
realLife: The city's 2023 board set a separate guideline to help the state housing agency decide qualifying tenant applications about the initial regulated rent after vacancy.
gates: The case record identifies the prior regulatory status, vacancy date and tenant application.
inGame: needs: prior regulatory status, vacancy date and tenant application.

turns.what: The state reviewer considers the specified maximum base rent adjustment.
The reviewer checks the ordinary renewal order.
turns.pulledBy: The unit was already stabilized at renewal
